_note: Financial metadata policy; no compliance certification. TLS version controls require an explicit packet metadata interface. Deny-domain matches isolate the client's forwarded IPv4 traffic.

trading._note: Trading floor / high-frequency systems. Not in AI isolation scope.

guest._note: Client / visitor WiFi. Deny-IP/Tor matches contribute a score; confirmed deny-domain matches isolate forwarded client IPv4.

dmz._note: Public-facing servers. SNI needs a metadata sensor; TLS version control requires an explicit packet interface.

ai_enforcement._note: Counts new TCP connections from one client to one server:port in 60 s and isolates the client for 15 min at 39 or more. It does not see passwords, logins or failed attempts; slower rates are not caught. Benign automation at about 1 request/s (pollers, monitoring) looks identical and will be isolated unless listed in exempt. Runs only in AI-enhanced protection (healthy DNS log). Isolation needs MINIFW_AI_ENFORCE_MODEL_SHA256 in /etc/minifw/minifw.env; otherwise shadow scoring only. Before enabling, fill segment_subnets and exempt (servers, pollers, proxies, shared NAT addresses).

collectors._zeek_note: Requires a separately provisioned Zeek sensor or packet interface for SNI; TLS version control uses the packet interface.
